description: Requires a PAID Apollo plan (the free plan answers 403). Enrich one specific person by email, LinkedIn URL, or name+domain/organization: title, seniority, department, employer, and (if your account has unlocked it) a work email. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey — this returns data your OWN Apollo licence already covers; Pipeworx caches nothing. Apollo cost: 1 credit if email/demographic data is found, +8 more only for a mobile phone (not requested by this tool, see `note` in the response), 0 if nothing matches. NOT implemented: phone-number reveal (Apollo delivers it asynchronously to a webhook, which this stateless tool call cannot receive). Example: apollo_enrich_person({ name: "Patrick Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

domain.description: Employer domain, e.g. "stripe.com". Helps disambiguate a common name.

name.description: Person's full name, e.g. "Patrick Collison". Alternative to first_name+last_name.

organization_name.description: Current or former employer NAME, e.g. "Stripe".

reveal_personal_emails.description: Default false. If true, also attempts to reveal a personal (non-work) email, consuming Apollo credit accordingly.

name: apollo_enrich_person
title: Apollo Enrich Person
